title: Lookup field
description: Inventory of fields populated by a Lookup. A lookup deliberately captures a value at set time (a snapshot) — often exactly what is intended (e.g. freezing a price, tax rate or address on a document). Listed for awareness, not as a defect.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A looked-up value is captured once at set time and does not follow later changes to the source. This is frequently the intended behavior; there are good reasons to freeze a value in a solution.
rule.remediation: No action needed in most cases. Only reconsider if the value is expected to stay in sync with its source — then a related field or calculation would keep it live.
